name: Guest WiFi QR Code
description: Generate a guest WiFi QR code that phones can scan to join the network.

hints.ssid: The payload follows the WIFI: convention so phones can join directly after scanning.
hints.output: The password is embedded in the payload, so share the code only with guests.

faq.a: Yes, it is generated entirely on the server with no network access.

faq.q: Do both iOS and Android scan it?
faq.a: Yes. The system camera and common scanners such as WeChat all understand the WIFI: format.
